Signed gradient paths yield integral Morse boundaries; 30 unit pivots from degree4 and 300 from degree5 give free H4 rank63 and H5 rank36; after homotopy cancellations, consecutive attaching dimensions justify wedge 63 S4 and 36 S5 (not a homology-only inference). For S3 action on rows 2,3,4, signed-orbit chain invariant computations over two odd primes not dividing 6 yield H4 invariant dimensions (49,35), H5 (8,22) for transposition and 3cycle, respectively; reconstruct χ4=(63,35,21), χ5=(36,-20,15). Fresh independent enumeration reconstructs all 19,979 augmented faces and their f-vector, plus signed simplicial Lefschetz traces 27,55,6 in identity, order2, order3 classes, consistent with the two character rows. Limits: this new check is an Euler/trace corroboration, not independent Smith or Morse rank reexecution.

originality.rationale: Earlier published generalized chessboard literature covers the very same (1,2,2,2) seven-column case at the level needed for the complete claim. Limonchenko–Yu 2026 Example 5.6 cites Reiner–Roberts for the torsion-free boundary case, and its connectivity bound gives at least 2-connectivity. Reiner–Roberts Theorem 3.3 gives rational homology by degree as S_gamma×S_delta representations for chessboard complexes with capacities (multiplicities); its weight-space formulas specialize at this row capacity to the rational Betti and S3 characters. Combining those prior tools with the known integral torsion-free result and standard low-dimensional CW homotopy arguments yields the asserted sphere wedge and row characters. The four-row seven-column same-parameter classification was therefore already mathematically implied; the numerical explicit specialization is not novel by itself.
residual_risks: The exact 63/36 and character arithmetic requires an explicit substitution into Reiner–Roberts Theorem 3.3; that full character table is not printed in its general theorem, but determining a specified weight-space multiplicity is routine, not a new independent classification.
Independent simple enumeration verified Euler/Lefschetz, not the source 30 and 300 unit Smith pivots; C relies on reconstructed exact integer-algorithm proof and source certificate.

value.rationale: The particular capacity redistribution boundary is mathematically natural and the exact integer computation is useful verification, but the asserted theorem and its S3 characters are determined from previously published general representation and same-case torsion results. Under the same value standard, known-table specialization without independent mathematical content does not qualify.
